name: Moin
blurb: Fast, low-latency voice chat and high-quality screen sharing for teams and communities.
description:
Fast, low-latency voice chat and high-quality screen sharing for teams and
communities.

Moin keeps conversations close to real time, so talking while you work or
play feels natural. Share a window or a whole screen with the people you
are talking to, in high quality and without a separate tool.

Create a space, invite the people you want, and start talking. Hardware
video encoding is used when your graphics card supports it. Without
one, screen sharing may use the OpenH264 Video Codec provided by Cisco
Systems, Inc., which Moin downloads from Cisco the first time it runs;
Settings › Video turns it off.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
